# #1798: Patch: the card scripts' tests read def ids through the crate's one helper instead of about 130 hand-written copies
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The tests beside each card's script often need the list of which cards are in a player's hand, graveyard or deck. The cards crate already has one small helper for exactly that. Most tests write it out again by hand anyway, and many define a private copy under a dozen different names; a few of those copies even hide the shared one. Once built, they all call the shared helper. The tests stay the same, with fewer lines and one spelling for a reader, or the next card's author, to copy.

## Why
- `crates/cards/src/lib.rs:267-271` already has it: `#[cfg(test)] pub(crate) fn def_ids(cards: &[CardInstance]) -> Vec<String>`.
- Searching `crates/cards/src/scripts` for `.hand(..)` or `.pile(..)` followed by `.iter()` or `.into_iter()` and `.map(|c| c.def_id…)` finds 131 copies in 77 files.
- 41 of those copies are local helper functions with that one-line body, in 37 files. Examples:
  - `hand_defs` (`classic/c009_income_tax.rs:240`)
  - `hand_ids` (`core/c098_heroic_power.rs:232`), which returns def ids despite its name
  - `def_ids_in_hand` (`core/c037_gravedigger.rs:83`)
  - `hand_def_ids` (`core/c051_kys_private_tutor.rs:411`)
- Four files declare their own `fn def_ids`, with different signatures, that hides the crate's: `classic/c050_voidwalker.rs:85`, `classic/c056_spell_tyrant.rs:113`, `classic/c071_lane_eater.rs:140` and `core/c042_eugenics.rs:196`.
- #1786 did the same for the engine's rule tests, taking `both`, `spread` and the JSON helpers from the shared harness.

## Proposal
- Mechanically replace each copy with `def_ids(&s.hand(P))` or `def_ids(&s.pile(P, "graveyard"))`, and delete the local wrappers.
- Rename or remove the four shadowing `def_ids`. Keep a local helper only where its signature really differs (Lane Eater's `Vec<Option<…>>`), under a name that hides nothing.
- Only `#[cfg(test)]` code changes. No script, test name or assertion changes.

## Where it lands
- The test modules under `crates/cards/src/scripts/**`, about 77 files
- CLAUDE.md rule 6 (a card's tests sit beside its script). No spec change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards -- --list` prints the same test names before and after.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` pass.
- [ ] No local function under `crates/cards/src/scripts` has only that `.map(|c| c.def_id…).collect()` as its body, and no script's test module declares its own `fn def_ids`.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` reports no card that plays differently (the change is test-only), and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks
Many files, little substance: mechanical edits to about 77 card files, roughly 200 lines removed. Touching card files runs the whole Rust CI. A careless edit could change an assertion; the unchanged test list and green tests guard against that.
